summary: Deprovision a controller node with automation-controller-service stop, then awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<name> from another node; remove leftover groups with awx-manage unregister_queue --queuename=<name>, and remove instances from both the API and inventory so setup does not re-add them.
questions: How do I deprovision an instance with awx-manage?
How do I remove an unused instance group?
Why did my instance get added back to an instance group after setup?

answer_card.title: Deprovision a controller instance
answer_card.answer_md:
On the instance:

```
automation-controller-service stop
```

From another instance:

```
awx-manage deprovision_instance --hostname=<name used in inventory file>
```

Instance groups are not removed automatically; remove unused ones with:

```
awx-manage unregister_queue --queuename=<name>
```

To keep an instance out of a group, remove it through the API **and** from the inventory file.
